direction: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
purpose: Retry the same frozen-bundle WL and receipt-only support renewal with a corrected start receipt and process-group cleanup, after v1 failed before any state promotion.

v1_failure_chain.first_deployer_cause: Cluster repository remote is named fork rather than the local name myfork; launcher was never extracted and action root was absent.
v1_failure_chain.second_deployer_cause: The v1 launcher required a new_snapshot log line that the immutable WL monitor never emits.

execution_amendments.start_receipt: Require one fresh WL output directory whose matrix binds prior/current snapshots, run counts, batch threshold, exact commits and zero-resource effect fields; do not require a nonexistent log event.
execution_amendments.process_isolation: Start WL and receipt monitors in separate setsid process groups.
execution_amendments.failure_cleanup: On launcher failure, terminate each exact process group and verify all descendants and locks are gone before returning failure.
execution_amendments.fresh_action_root: Use outcome-blind-no-fit-support-renewal-20260901-v2 and never reuse or modify the v1 partial output.

authorized_actions.wl: Start one exact frozen-bundle WL snapshot-chain monitor with 72 polls x 300 seconds and minimum_new_runs=12.
authorized_actions.receipt: Start one exact receipt-only common-support monitor with 72 polls x 300 seconds and stable_polls=3.
authorized_actions.transition: FORBIDDEN; the installed transition scorer performs six deterministic HGB fits.
authorized_actions.config_v2: No restart and no content read.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_wl_promotes: The frozen WL escrow has independently verified structural coverage for the promoted snapshot.
forbidden: transition common-support completion before a separate authorization
